createAccount.question: How do I create an account?
createAccount.answer: Download the EventEz app, tap "Sign up" and fill out the form with your email and password. You'll receive a confirmation email.

editProfile.question: How do I edit my profile?
editProfile.answer: Go to Profile > Edit profile. You can change your photo, name, email and other personal information.

changePassword.question: How do I change my password?
changePassword.answer: Go to Profile > Settings > Security > Change password. Enter your old password then the new one.

becomeOrganizer.question: How do I become an organizer?
becomeOrganizer.answer: From your profile, tap "Become an organizer". Fill in the required information (organization type, contact details). Your request will be processed quickly.

findEvents.question: How do I find events?
findEvents.answer: Use the "Discover" tab to browse events. You can filter by category, date, location or use search.

registerEvent.question: How do I register for an event?
registerEvent.answer: Open the event page and tap the registration or ticket purchase button. Follow the steps to complete your registration.

followEvent.question: How do I follow an event?
followEvent.answer: Tap the bookmark icon on the event page. You'll find your followed events in the "Saved" tab.

addToCalendar.question: How do I add an event to my calendar?
addToCalendar.answer: On the event page, tap the calendar icon in the "Share" section. Choose Google Calendar or download the iCal file.

paymentMethods.question: Which payment methods are accepted?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money, credit cards (Visa, Mastercard), PayPal and bank transfers.

requestRefund.question: How do I request a refund?
requestRefund.answer: Go to Profile > My payments, select the relevant payment and tap "Request a refund". Refund conditions depend on the organizer.

paymentFailed.question: My payment failed, what should I do?
paymentFailed.answer: Check your balance and try again. If the issue persists, contact support with your transaction number. Pending payments expire after 30 minutes.

findTickets.question: Where do I find my tickets?
findTickets.answer: Your tickets are in the "My Tickets" tab. Each ticket contains a unique QR code for event entry.

qrCodeWorks.question: How does the QR code work?
qrCodeWorks.answer: Show your QR code at the event entrance. The organizer will scan it to validate your registration. You can also save it offline.

transferTicket.question: Can I transfer my ticket?
transferTicket.answer: Ticket transfers depend on the organizer's conditions. If allowed, go to the ticket details and use the "Transfer" option.

appNotWorking.question: The app is not working properly
appNotWorking.answer: Try closing and reopening the app. Check that you have the latest version. If the issue persists, uninstall and reinstall the app.

noNotifications.question: I'm not receiving notifications
noNotifications.answer: Check that notifications are enabled for EventEz in your phone settings. Also go to Profile > Settings > Notifications to configure your preferences.

deleteAccount.question: How do I delete my account?
deleteAccount.answer: Go to Profile > Settings > Account > Delete my account. This action is irreversible. All your data will be deleted in accordance with our privacy policy.

privacyLegal.finalText: Your data is protected. We take your privacy seriously.
